meta.summary: Complete forensic audit of all prior repository workbooks (root, docs/, session-1944e5a3, session-a3a8ec08, session-b4ec6128, session-5bb36a1b, session-e618ace7, session-18dacdea, and session-343c7030) against live primary Tier A/B official records on 2026-11-08.

cross_session_findings.finding: Sessions D & H (session-18dacdea M-73) cited 'FEMA NRI Urban LA: 89.6 composite (97.8 earthquake percentile)' as a county/urban benchmark while linking USGS FAQ S22.
cross_session_findings.evidence_and_fix: Live FEMA lookup confirms 89.6 (89.59 composite, 96.9 EQ) belongs exclusively to single Census Tract 06037295103, whereas LA County ranks #1 nationally with $3.9B EAL, 1.36 CRF, and $5.3B Risk Value (S36).

cross_session_findings.area: Over-Flagged Official Facts in Session I
cross_session_findings.finding: Session I (session-343c7030 R-02, R-05, R-08, R-09, R-11, R-13) marked USGS EQ FAQ as 404 and flagged CDI $1B FAIR Plan, BEA $818.5B PI, LA City $18.42/hr wage, County 0.11% DTT, and Nov 2026 ULA repeal rumors as unverified.
cross_session_findings.evidence_and_fix: All six were directly verified live on 2026-11-08 (S12, S13, S18, S26, S28, S34, S35): USGS FAQ is live; SOS PR26-95 proves ULA repeal 25-0006A1 was withdrawn Jun 25, 2026 while Prop 43 is failing 56.8% No.

cross_session_findings.area: California Top Income Tax Sunset Ignored Until Prop 3 (Nov 2026)
cross_session_findings.finding: All eight earlier builds applied California's 13.30% top tax rate without noting that Prop 55 top brackets (10.3%–12.3%) were scheduled to expire after 2030 during the lease expiry window.
cross_session_findings.evidence_and_fix: Verified live from LAO & CA SOS Nov 7, 2026 tally (S28): Proposition 3 is passing 60.3% Yes, permanently extending Prop 30/55 high-income brackets past 2030 alongside the 1% Behavioral Health Services Tax (S30).

cross_session_findings.area: Stale $1.7B Debt Figure & Missed May 2031 Securitization ARD Wall
cross_session_findings.finding: Session F (session-5bb36a1b F-11) cited stale FY25 '~$1.7B securitized debt' and most builds missed the exact May 2031 maturity wall inside the owner's 2030–2035 lease expiry window.
cross_session_findings.evidence_and_fix: Q3 FY26 10-Q carrying debt is $1,472.83M ($44.15M current + $1,428.67M LT), and June 23, 2026 Form 8-K confirms $500M 7.624% Class A-2 Notes hit their Anticipated Repayment Date in May 2031 (S33).

cross_session_findings.area: Optical Net Income vs. Continuing-Ops & Cash Burn Divergence
cross_session_findings.finding: Session G (session-e618ace7 R-08) spotlighted JACK's +$27.91M 9-mo FY26 GAAP profit without disclosing continuing-operations deterioration or non-recurring cash bridges.
cross_session_findings.evidence_and_fix: Q3 FY26 10-Q/8-K proves continuing-ops earnings fell -35.6% ($47.97M) and OCF dropped -52.1% ($56.55M incl. $11.0M franchisee deferrals), bridged by $80.42M COLI surrender and $26.68M asset sales (S32).

cross_session_findings.finding: Session H (M-66) and Session D cited outdated 50–100 FY26 closure guidance and FY25 19.6% margin without the August 12, 2026 Q3 guidance revision.
cross_session_findings.evidence_and_fix: August 12, 2026 Form 8-K cut FY26 store margin guidance to ~16.5% (16.6% YTD), guided 50–60 closures (~25 openings, ~2,100 YE units), and cut franchise margin guidance to ~$265M (S32).

cross_session_findings.area: LAUSD Graduation Rate & Fed Funds Snapshot Discrepancies
